examples.en: Do you know who won the race?
examples.zh: 你知道谁赢了比赛吗？

examples.en: I lost the race today.
examples.zh: 我今天比赛输了。

examples.en: We ate mutton soup and dumplings.
examples.zh: 我们喝了羊肉汤，吃了饺子。

examples.en: Steamed dumplings are a popular Chinese breakfast.
examples.zh: 蒸饺是受欢迎的中国早餐。

examples.en: We made apple dumplings for dessert.
examples.zh: 我们做了苹果饺子当甜点。

examples.en: I eat a rice dumpling on Dragon Boat Festival.
examples.zh: 我在端午节吃粽子。

examples.en: My mom makes rice dumplings with meat.
examples.zh: 我妈妈用肉做粽子。

examples.en: This rice dumpling is sweet and good.
examples.zh: 这个粽子又甜又好吃。

examples.en: We like Scottish dancing and music.
examples.zh: 我们喜欢苏格兰舞蹈和音乐。

examples.en: The Scottish Highlands are very beautiful.
examples.zh: 苏格兰高地非常美丽。

examples.en: This is Scottish law for people.
examples.zh: 这是为人们制定的苏格兰法律。

examples.en: Haggis is nice, and you can eat it every day.
examples.zh: 哈吉斯很好吃，你可以每天吃它。

examples.en: They played music, and then a man talked to the haggis.
examples.zh: 他们演奏了音乐，然后一个人对着哈吉斯说话。

examples.en: Vegetarian haggis is food for people who don't eat meat.
examples.zh: 素食哈吉斯是不吃肉的人吃的食物。

examples.en: This is an oven-proof dish.
examples.zh: 这是一个耐热盘子。

examples.en: Have you washed the dishes?
examples.zh: 你洗过盘子了吗？

examples.en: This dish is chicken.
examples.zh: 这道菜是鸡肉做的。

examples.en: This is a book of love poems.
examples.zh: 这是一本爱情诗集。

examples.en: She read some new poems to us.
examples.zh: 她给我们读了一些新诗。

examples.en: He wrote a short poem for his mom.
examples.zh: 他为他妈妈写了一首短诗。

examples.en: A young lady is here to see you.
examples.zh: 一位年轻女士在这里要见你。

examples.en: Be careful, ladies are here!
examples.zh: 小心点，女士们在这里！

examples.en: Kids, say thank you to the lady.
examples.zh: 孩子们，对这位女士说谢谢。

examples.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the show starts now.
examples.zh: 女士们先生们，演出现在开始。

examples.en: This gentleman has a question for you.
examples.zh: 这位先生有个问题要问你。

examples.en: He is a kind gentleman.
examples.zh: 他是一位善良的绅士。

examples.en: The fire spread fast because of the wind.
examples.zh: 因为风，火蔓延得很快。

examples.en: It began in the liver, then spread to other parts.
examples.zh: 它从肝脏开始，然后扩散到其他部位。

examples.en: Art on walls can help spread a fire, so keep it small.
examples.zh: 墙上的画会助火蔓延，所以别挂太多。

examples.en: The cat sleeps on the doorstep.
examples.zh: 猫睡在门阶上。

examples.en: She left the shoes on the doorstep.
examples.zh: 她把鞋子留在门阶上。

examples.en: We sat on the doorstep at night.
examples.zh: 我们晚上坐在门阶上。

examples.en: A gold necklace hung around her neck.
examples.zh: 一条金项链挂在她脖子上。

examples.en: Keys were hanging from her belt.
examples.zh: 钥匙挂在她腰带上。

examples.en: Party things hung down from the ceiling.
examples.zh: 派对装饰物从天花板挂下来。

examples.en: I cry when I cut onions.
examples.zh: 我切洋葱时会哭。

examples.en: Cook the onion for two minutes.
examples.zh: 把洋葱煮两分钟。

examples.en: She puts onions in her soup.
examples.zh: 她在汤里放洋葱。

examples.en: I used Greek letters in the text to show you the graph shape.
examples.zh: 我在文本中用了希腊字母，好让你看到图表的形状。

examples.en: This tool makes small text look like grey bands, called Greeking.
examples.zh: 这个工具让小的文字看起来像灰色条，这叫希腊化显示。

examples.en: In shows, brand names were often changed to Greek names, like Nokia to Nokio.
examples.zh: 在电视剧里，品牌名常被改成希腊风格的名字，比如诺基亚变成诺基奥。

examples.en: Fireworks are an American tradition on July 4th.
examples.zh: 烟花是七月四日的美国传统。

examples.en: Switzerland has a long tradition of peace.
examples.zh: 瑞士有悠久的和平传统。

examples.en: Our office tradition: a cake on your birthday.
examples.zh: 我们办公室的传统：生日时带蛋糕。

examples.en: A heart is a symbol of love.
examples.zh: 心是爱的象征。

examples.en: The wheel in the Indian flag is a peace symbol.
examples.zh: 印度国旗上的轮子是和平的象征。

examples.en: Water is a symbol of life in her poems.
examples.zh: 水是她诗歌中生命的象征。

examples.en: There is a good movie on TV at midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜时电视上有一部好电影。

examples.en: We got home after midnight.
examples.zh: 我们午夜后才到家。

examples.en: The clock shows twelve at midnight.
examples.zh: 午夜时时钟显示十二点。

examples.en: Workers can strike for better pay.
examples.zh: 工人们可以为了更高的工资而罢工。

examples.en: We strike for more money and safety.
examples.zh: 我们为了更多的钱和安全而罢工。

examples.en: If disaster strikes, my family is safe.
examples.zh: 如果灾难来临，我的家人是安全的。

examples.en: Please put the jar into the cupboard.
examples.zh: 请把罐子放进橱柜里。

examples.en: Let's go into the garden.
examples.zh: 我们走进花园吧。

examples.en: Stop running! Get into bed now.
examples.zh: 别跑了！现在上床睡觉。

examples.en: I study hard in the hope of passing the exam.
examples.zh: 我努力学习，希望能通过考试。

examples.en: She saves money in the hope of buying a bike.
examples.zh: 她存钱，希望能买一辆自行车。

examples.en: He runs fast in the hope of winning the race.
examples.zh: 他跑得快，希望能赢得比赛。

examples.en: The road ahead has many cars.
examples.zh: 前面的路上有很多车。

examples.en: Go straight ahead and see the hospital.
examples.zh: 一直往前走，就能看到医院。

examples.en: Our team was ahead after 10 minutes.
examples.zh: 10分钟后，我们队领先了。

examples.en: Can I carry your bag for you?
examples.zh: 我能帮你拿包吗？

examples.en: She carried her sleepy boy to bed.
examples.zh: 她把困倦的男孩抱去睡觉。

examples.en: These books are too heavy to carry.
examples.zh: 这些书太重了，搬不动。

examples.en: Have you packed your suitcase yet?
examples.zh: 你收拾好手提箱了吗？

examples.en: Did you unpack your suitcase?
examples.zh: 你打开手提箱了吗？

examples.en: Is your suitcase ready for the trip?
examples.zh: 你的手提箱为旅行准备好了吗？

examples.en: The museum is six blocks from here.
examples.zh: 博物馆离这里有六个街区。

examples.en: My friend and I live on the same block.
examples.zh: 我和我的朋友住在同一个街区。

examples.en: The tall building takes up one city block.
examples.zh: 那栋高楼占了一个城市街区。

examples.en: This hotel is for travellers, not tourists on short trips.
examples.zh: 这家酒店是为旅行者准备的，不是为短途游客准备的。

examples.en: The travellers and six cars moved here this week.
examples.zh: 旅行者和六辆汽车本周搬到了这里。

examples.en: The school has 15 children from traveller homes.
examples.zh: 这所学校有15个来自旅行者家庭的孩子。

examples.en: We can go wherever you like.
examples.zh: 我们可以去任何你喜欢的地方。

examples.en: Wherever I go, I see him.
examples.zh: 无论我去哪里，我都会看到他。

examples.en: Wherever you look, fewer people marry.
examples.zh: 无论你看哪里，结婚的人越来越少。

examples.en: She plays the violin very well.
examples.zh: 她小提琴拉得很好。

examples.en: Your violin string is flat.
examples.zh: 你的小提琴弦音不准了。

examples.en: A cello sounds deeper than a violin.
examples.zh: 大提琴的声音比小提琴低沉。

examples.en: Teaching lively kids is hard work.
examples.zh: 教一群有生气的孩子是辛苦的工作。

examples.en: This city is big and lively.
examples.zh: 这座城市又大又热闹。

examples.en: They show lively interest in their grandkids.
examples.zh: 他们对孙辈表现出浓厚的兴趣。

examples.en: I like to eat spring rolls for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐喜欢吃春卷。

examples.en: My mom makes spring rolls on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我妈妈在星期天做春卷。

examples.en: The spring roll is hot and yummy.
examples.zh: 这个春卷又热又好吃。

examples.en: Can you wait a moment?
examples.zh: 你能等一下吗？

examples.en: I will be ready in a moment.
examples.zh: 我马上就好。

examples.en: A car came, and a few moments later the bell rang.
examples.zh: 一辆车来了，过了一会儿门铃响了。

examples.en: I am doing my homework at the moment.
examples.zh: 我现在正在做作业。

examples.en: She is watching TV at the moment.
examples.zh: 她此刻正在看电视。

examples.en: They were playing football at the moment.
examples.zh: 他们当时正在踢足球。

examples.en: Tonight is my first time to meet her.
examples.zh: 今晚是我第一次见到她。

examples.en: Tonight's meeting is in the school hall.
examples.zh: 今晚的会议在学校大厅举行。

examples.en: The game is on TV at 8 tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚8点电视上播放这场比赛。

examples.en: People put colorful paper lanterns in their homes.
examples.zh: 人们把彩色的纸灯笼放在家里。

examples.en: Red lanterns are for the New Year festival.
examples.zh: 红灯笼是为新年准备的。

examples.en: We will put lanterns in the trees for the party.
examples.zh: 我们要把灯笼挂在树上，为了派对。

examples.en: The Matterhorn is a very high mountain in Europe.
examples.zh: 马特洪峰是欧洲一座很高的山。

examples.en: Kilimanjaro is the tallest mountain in Africa.
examples.zh: 乞力马扎罗山是非洲最高的山。

examples.en: Big mountains and fast rivers cut the land.
examples.zh: 大山和急流把这片土地分开了。

examples.en: The plane climbed high into the sky.
examples.zh: 飞机爬升到了高空中。

examples.en: The road climbs up the mountain.
examples.zh: 这条路向山上爬升。

examples.en: The sun climbed higher in the sky.
examples.zh: 太阳在天空中升得更高了。

examples.en: Honey is a natural sweet thing.
examples.zh: 蜂蜜是一种天然的甜东西。

examples.en: Drinking milk is more natural for babies.
examples.zh: 对婴儿来说，喝牛奶更自然。

examples.en: The old man died from natural reasons.
examples.zh: 这位老人因自然原因去世。

examples.en: This area has great natural beauty.
examples.zh: 这个地区有很美的自然风光。

examples.en: She thinks beauty is inside you.
examples.zh: 她认为美在你的心里。

examples.en: The music he played was full of beauty.
examples.zh: 他演奏的音乐充满了美。

examples.en: I respect his ideas, but I don't agree with them.
examples.zh: 我尊重他的想法，但我不同意它们。

examples.en: She is a strong woman and we all respect her.
examples.zh: 她是一个坚强的女人，我们都尊敬她。

examples.en: New teachers must get respect from their students.
examples.zh: 新老师必须赢得学生的尊敬。

examples.en: You should listen to your elders.
examples.zh: 你应该听长辈的话。

examples.en: They asked the village elders.
examples.zh: 他们问了村里的长辈。

examples.en: She is my elder by three years.
examples.zh: 她比我大三岁。

examples.en: I want a double coffee, please.
examples.zh: 请给我一杯双份咖啡。

examples.en: Go through the double doors and turn left.
examples.zh: 穿过双扇门，然后左转。

examples.en: The word "cool" has a double "o" in it.
examples.zh: 单词“cool”中间有两个“o”。

examples.en: I like the house, but I won't live there forever.
examples.zh: 我喜欢这房子，但我不会永远住在那儿。

examples.en: He is always losing his keys forever.
examples.zh: 他总是永远丢钥匙。

examples.en: She is always late, forever.
examples.zh: 她总是永远迟到。

examples.en: They decorated the car with flowers.
examples.zh: 他们用花装饰了汽车。

examples.en: We will decorate the kitchen next week.
examples.zh: 我们下周会装饰厨房。

examples.en: I don't like the paint smell when decorating.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢装饰时油漆的味道。

examples.en: We put up a map on the wall.
examples.zh: 我们在墙上挂了一张地图。

examples.en: She put up a picture in her room.
examples.zh: 她在房间里张贴了一张图片。

examples.en: They put up posters for the school party.
examples.zh: 他们为学校聚会张贴了海报。

examples.en: We put Spring Festival couplets on the door.
examples.zh: 我们把春联贴在门上。

examples.en: I like the red Spring Festival couplets.
examples.zh: 我喜欢红色的春联。

examples.en: My dad buys Spring Festival couplets every year.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每年都买春联。

examples.en: She called me beforehand to tell me.
examples.zh: 她事先打电话告诉了我。

examples.en: He knew his speech would make people angry beforehand.
examples.zh: 他事先知道他的演讲会让人生气。

examples.en: You should get your things ready beforehand.
examples.zh: 你应该事先把东西准备好。

examples.en: Did you prepare for the talk?
examples.zh: 你为谈话做好准备了吗？

examples.en: She will prepare food and keep it cold.
examples.zh: 她会准备好食物并冷藏起来。

examples.en: This class prepares kids for new jobs.
examples.zh: 这门课为孩子们的新工作做准备。

examples.en: The word "flight" has two meanings: plane travel and running away.
examples.zh: 单词“flight”有两个意思：乘飞机旅行和逃跑。

examples.en: The meaning of his hand move was clear.
examples.zh: 他手势的意思很清楚。

examples.en: His books have a hidden meaning.
examples.zh: 他的书有一个隐藏的意义。

examples.en: They work during the night and sleep in the day.
examples.zh: 他们在夜间工作，白天睡觉。

examples.en: Planes got much better during the war.
examples.zh: 战争期间，飞机变得好多了。

examples.en: I woke up two times during the night.
examples.zh: 我夜里醒了两次。

examples.en: I don't like to be the last to come to class.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢最后一个到教室。

examples.en: He was the last person to see the woman, so people thought he did it.
examples.zh: 他是最后一个见到那位女士的人，所以人们觉得是他干的。

examples.en: Our house is the last one on the left before the red light.
examples.zh: 我们的房子是红绿灯前左边的最后一栋。

examples.en: We waited for you till 6:30.
examples.zh: 我们等你一直到六点半。

examples.en: Women in Britain couldn't vote till 1918.
examples.zh: 英国的妇女直到1918年才能投票。

examples.en: How many days till the baby comes?
examples.zh: 离宝宝出生还有多少天？

examples.en: His heart is not healthy.
examples.zh: 他的心脏不健康。

examples.en: Isabel's heart beat fast because she was scared.
examples.zh: 伊莎贝尔因为害怕，心跳得很快。

examples.en: She has a heart problem.
examples.zh: 她有一个心脏问题。
